blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — China acknowledged on Saturday the Philippines’ cooperation in the repatriation of more than 100 Chinese previously arrested in separate raids on suspected illegal offshore gaming hubs. The Chinese Embassy in Manila said Chinese and Philippine law enforcement agencies jointly deported 115 Chinese suspects linked to gambling and fraud on Nov. 6. “China appreciates the assistance provided by relevant Philippine law enforcement authorities,” the embassy said in a statement. It described the repatriation as “another major achievement in our joint efforts to combat transnational crime.” The statement followed the Bureau of Immigration’s (BI) deportation of 115 Chinese nabbed during […]...
